import sys, json, math
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
import controller
req = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/request.json'))
case = req['cases'][0]
raw = json.dumps(req).encode()
res = controller.run(raw)
r = res['results'][0]
print('ratio', r['ratio'], 'utility', r['utility'], 'age', r['age'])
print('assignment', r['assignment'])
print('flow len', len(r['flow']), 'pot len', len(r['potential']), 'cut', r['cut'])
# rebuild
parsed = controller._parse(raw)
c = parsed[0]
import probability
thr = probability.window_thresholds(c['stats'], c['windows'])
cv = c['class_values']
values = [c['windows'][j][6]*cv[r['predictions'][j]] for j in range(len(c['windows']))]
elig = [c['windows'][j][5] < r['thresholds'][j] for j in range(len(c['windows']))]
model = controller._build_arcs(c, values, elig)
arcs = model['arcs']
print('arcs', len(arcs), 'nodes', model['nodes'])
# check conservation and bounds
K = model['nodes']
net=[0]*K
for i,(u,v,lo,hi,co) in enumerate(arcs):
    net[u]-=r['flow'][i]; net[v]+=r['flow'][i]
